## Supervisor v0.8.2

### Fixes
- **"Not responding" while choosing a file (Linux):** saving or opening a file (exporting the calendar, saving an invite, importing events or students, choosing the backup folder, saving the key file backup, opening another data file) no longer makes GNOME warn that Supervisor isn't responding while you browse for a location. The window keeps working while the file chooser is open.

### Notes
- Existing data files open unchanged.
